posts.title: The Next App Is No App
posts.description: I have been building apps for my customers since 2010. The next step is not a better app. It is no app at all: their own AI agent connects to my platform and does the work with them. This week the first customers started using it.

posts.title: Laggy Legs
posts.description: My Apple Watch records more than pace and heart rate. While I run, it also measures running dynamics: how long each foot stays on the ground, how long my stride is, how much I bounce, and an estimate of my power. I never looked at those numbers. This week I set up a new centralised store of all my Health data, enabling me to put three marathons side by side: Valencia 2024, Eindhoven 2025 and The H

posts.title: Looking Out the Window
posts.description: This weekend I ran the marathon of The Hague. I gave everything, and the result was 3 hours and 40 minutes. I am satisfied, because I know there was really nothing more in it. Tired legs, maximum heart rate, and still no collapse. It is beautiful that you can look for the limit like that. But the most important part of this marathon did not happen on the road.
